headline: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

meeting.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meeting.summary: The committee deleted two action items and amended others on cesspools, shoreline access and wildfire.
meeting.recap: The committee held off on a South Kīhei Road flooding goal until Public Works can help.[[0:05:27]] Members voted 8–0 to delete action 3.02.[[0:32:22]] A motion rewrote action 3.06 to work with property owners on cesspool and septic conversion or connection plans by the state deadline.[[1:15:00]] Action 3.07 was reworded as an inventory of shoreline natural and cultural resources affected by sea level rise and poor land management.[[1:28:13]] Action 3.08 on shoreline access was reworded to focus on access that may be affected by development.[[1:46:32]] Members approved raising the cost of action 3.09 to $10 million.[[1:55:56]] A motion added "to the extent permissible by law" to action 3.14.[[2:28:55]] The committee will pick up at action 3.15 tomorrow.[[2:31:29]]
decided: Members voted to delete action 3.02 on page 127.
Members approved raising the cost of action 3.09 to $10 million.
meeting.next: Lawyers will check the use of the word "ensure" in wording about landowners following the 2024 South Maui wildfire protection plan. The Planning Department will find where pages 59 and 60 of the 2016 wildfire plan match the 2024 plan.

moments.q: "You guys are the shining star right now."
